_comment: C0-9 正文英译 · stripe-mcp（2026-10-25）。无 extraSections（内置五节由 axes/leads/runs/unknowns/related 承载）。

axes.model_access:
**It calls no model itself** — an interface implementation called by MCP clients. It wraps Stripe dashboard capabilities
(product/price/customer/payment queries, docs retrieval) as tools for agents.
axes.runtime:
Mainly a local process (Python/TS packages starting stdio); GitHub stripe/ai 2,000★,
last push 2026-10-30 (API verified). Stripe also has an agentic commerce product line (ACP etc.) —
that is a separate layer of "agents taking payments directly" and does not count as this server itself.
axes.local_files: Never touches the local file system — the scope is Stripe cloud account data (customers/products/invoices etc.).
axes.background: stdio lives and dies with the client; no background-task semantics.
axes.tools:
Stripe API retrieval, account data queries, docs search, etc.; write capabilities (creating products/prices) exist —
the complete inventory follows the repo README, not enumerated item by item.
axes.context: No server-side cross-session memory — state lives in the Stripe account itself.
axes.permissions:
**Credential = Stripe API key, everything follows the key's permissions**: the difference between test and live keys is huge.
The official tooling supports trimming by key type and tool allowlists; payment write operations (refunds/sending invoices) genuinely exist —
before hooking up an agent, defend against the worst case of the key's permissions.
axes.fit:
Fits: letting an agent look up API usage, query account objects, and try test-mode operations while developing Stripe integrations.
Not a fit: hard "read-only insurance" boundaries; non-Stripe stacks.

mcp.transport:
**stdio** (Python/TS packages starting a local process) is primary; the official docs also describe a remote line — not verified item by item.
Verified: docs.stripe.com/agentic-commerce 200, stripe/ai repo (direct fetch 2026-10-21).
mcp.auth:
Stripe API key (test/live states); key permissions = the upper bound of tool permissions.
Support surface of restricted keys not verified item by item.
mcp.scope:
Read surface: account object queries, API reference retrieval; write surface: create products/prices, invoice and refund tools exist.
Tool-allowlist trimming can narrow it; no official docs for a tool-level human approval mechanism.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/mcp/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/mcp/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- The full tool inventory and write-tool details (not enumerated item by item)
- The granularity of restricted-keys support (not verified item by item)
- The current status of the hosted remote line (not verified item by item)
related: Both "dev-tooling servers": both state plainly that "credential permissions = the security boundary".
sources: Stripe · official agentic commerce docs (tooling line wording, direct-fetched and verified 2026-10-21)
